subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as synonym of the given word.

Unpleasant
solution:
The correct answer is: **Nasty.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Unpleasant"** means something that is not enjoyable or agreeable; it can cause discomfort or displeasure. (अप्रिय)

 
 
• **Example: **The weather was so unpleasant that we decided to stay indoors all day.
 
 
 
• **"Nasty"** refers to something that is very bad, unpleasant, or offensive. (गंदा, भद्दा)
 
 
• **Example: **He had a nasty fall while playing soccer and had to be taken to the hospital.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'Unpleasant'** is **'Nasty'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Nebulous** (धुंधला): Something that is vague, unclear, or ill-defined.

 
 
• **Example:** His plans for the future are still nebulous and not well defined.
 
 
 
• **Natal** (जन्म संबंधी): Related to the place or time of one's birth.
 
 
• **Example:** She returned to her natal home to celebrate the festival with her family.
 
 
 
• **Negligible** (नगण्य): So small or unimportant as to be not worth considering.
 
 
• **Example:** The difference in performance between the two models is negligible.
